citations.title: British American Tobacco - Tadeu Marroco

sentences.text: Tadeu Marroco, a Brazilian national, has been Chief Executive of British American Tobacco p.l.c. since 15 May 2023, succeeding Jack Bowles.

sentences.quote:
1992: Joins Souza Cruz in Brazil and experiences various finance roles across the business, including in Marketing, Operations and Leaf
2003: Becomes Finance Director for BAT Venezuela and, in 2005, for BAT Colombia as well
2006: Appointed Management Finance Controller in London
2007: Becomes Group Head of Operations Finance
sentences.text: He joined the group in 1992 at Souza Cruz in Brazil, holding finance roles across marketing, operations and leaf, before becoming Finance Director for BAT Venezuela in 2003 and for BAT Colombia in 2005, then Management Finance Controller in London in 2006 and Group Head of Operations Finance in 2007.

sentences.quote: I became Chief Executive in May 2023, having been appointed Finance Director in August 2019, and Deputy Finance Director in March of the same year.
sentences.text: He joined the Management Board as Director, Business Development in 2014, became Regional Director, Western Europe in 2016 and Regional Director, Europe and North Africa in 2018, then Director, Group Transformation in January 2019, joining the main board as Finance and Transformation Director in August 2019.

mgmt_bio.text: He joined the group in 1992 at Souza Cruz in Brazil, holding finance roles across marketing, operations and leaf, before becoming Finance Director for BAT Venezuela in 2003 and for BAT Colombia in 2005, then Management Finance Controller in London in 2006 and Group Head of Operations Finance in 2007.

sentences.text: British American Tobacco's smokeless products reached 19.8% of group revenue in the first half of 2026, up 1.6 percentage points versus full-year 2025, supporting its transformation case.

sentences.quote: New Categories revenue up 18.0%2 and New Categories contribution margin up 3.3 ppts to 13.8%2.
sentences.text: New Categories revenue grew 18.0% at constant rates with contribution margin up 3.3 points to 13.8%, showing the growth portfolio is scaling profitably.

sentences.quote: We further extended our global category leadership in Modern Oral, now our largest New Category (by revenue), achieving 39.2% volume share in our top markets4, up 8.4 ppts versus FY2025. Revenue grew 65.9%2
sentences.text: Modern Oral is now BAT's largest New Category by revenue, with 65.9% constant-currency growth and a 39.2% volume share in its top markets.
Combustibles still fund the transformation, with revenue up 2.1% and the U.S. region up 8.5% to 5.7 billion pounds.

Cash returns are a core pillar: BAT targets over 50 billion pounds of free cash flow before dividends from 2024 to 2030 and cites a 27-year record of dividend growth, alongside a 2.0% dividend increase and a 1.3 billion pound buyback announced for 2026.
